verdict.rationale: The docs show broad API coverage of the platform's main workflows. Onboarding can be done API-only as an alternative to the hosted UI, legal entities have their own API, balance accounts can be created via the Configuration API, splits and chargebacks are set in API calls, and webhooks plus an official MCP server support programmatic and agent use. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, fee control is described as managed in the Dashboard, and webhook troubleshooting points to Customer Area tools. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that Dashboard-managed functions (fee control, webhook troubleshooting) are exposed via API, a public OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.
